title: A great way to orientate yourself to the City Espciallt if you are here for the 1st time.
text:
Being walk to all the sites and take our time. Lots of fun answering the questions. Very informative. Well worth the money.
Wish there was a choice to listen to the info about each stop instead of reading.
author: Karen_N

title: Beautiful city
text: Mateo was a great guide. Gave a lot of interesting information about each spot along the tour. We saw a ton of buildings and gardens in a short period of time. A very high yield tour. Highly recommend!
author: Laura_A
